is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 3, section 2.1.3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports on Vgsc L995F/S (kdr), Cyp9k1 copy number variants, and Cyp6aa1 duplication (page 6-7, Figure 1).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports frequency changes for Cyp9k1_Dup8 (e.g., East 43% to 51%, West 84% to 93%) and Vgsc-995F haplotypes (e.g., 2% to 8.3% in Western Uganda) (page 6, 8).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Uganda during the LLINEUP trial (page 2, section 2.1.1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original research article reporting on genomic surveillance of field-collected mosquitoes (page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study reports data from 104 health sub-districts in Eastern and Western Uganda (page 2, section 2.1.1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study compares baseline (2017-2018) and 25-month post-intervention populations (page 2, 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study uses samples from the LLINEUP trial, which is a standard, large-scale clinical trial. While the samples are part of a larger project (MalariaGEN), this paper presents a specific genomic analysis of these samples.

supplement.evidence: The necessary data regarding genotype frequencies and study results are provided in the main text and figures.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the genomic impact of pyrethroid-only vs. PBO-pyrethroid bed nets on Anopheles gambiae populations in Uganda. It finds no significant decline in effective population size but identifies net-specific selective sweeps at loci including Cyp9k1, 2La, and a novel X-chromosome locus containing the Dgk gene.
